capabilities: dynamically highlights all occurrences of the selected text and of regex/keyword queries with custom CSS and capture groups
builds a sidebar index of ==highlight== text organized by heading hierarchy
shows floating teleprompter windows that follow the document, cursor, lyrics or reading position
reads notes aloud with local TTS engines and exports selections as audio files
performs regex find and replace with a preview, and plays music with karaoke lyrics in a sidebar panel
disambiguation: Not a file-preview tool despite the name; the core is dynamic text highlighting, with teleprompter, read-aloud and music as extra modules.
extras: Only Source and Live Preview modes are supported; the teleprompter and read-aloud are desktop-only, and the README is written primarily in Chinese with an English section. Sponsors are accepted.
problem: Obsidian's editor cannot highlight every occurrence of the selected text or persistently mark regex query matches with custom styles and widgets.

relations.evidence: this Music module is modified from two MIT projects — LyricFlux
modified from LyricFlux and obsidian-lyric (both MIT licensed)
the Regex find & replace module is ported with reference to obsidian-regex-replace

summary: Highlights selected text and regex query matches in the editor, plus a highlight index, teleprompter, TTS read-aloud, regex find & replace, and music player.
